requirements.requirement: Welcome action begins a birthday experience personalized for Malika.
All five scenes are reachable.
Cat responds; ladybugs open associated notes.
Each heart scores at most once.
Victory occurs at target; score stops after victory.
The collection contains 30 notes and five future-facing dream entries.
Names are filled; no fabricated past relationship memories are presented as fact.
Birthday letter identifies Malika and is signed by Zack, without audio dependency.
Secret letters unlock on victory; game restart preserves discovered notes.
Semantic keyboard-operable interactions with visible focus.
Nonessential motion respects reduced-motion preferences.
Responsive at 320px, tablet and desktop.
Core requires no backend, paid API, analytics, or external runtime service.
Repository contains state, provenance, requirements, status and evidence.
The garden love blossom progresses from notes, hearts, and released wishes; its stable button name is paired with an accessible stage description and it reveals a short authored note when fully open.
